Subject: Intro + short qual before demo — FinTrack

Hi Samir —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood. I own inbound SDR and will set up a short intro/demo with one of our solutions engineers. Before we lock a time, two quick asks so we tailor the session: 

1) Primary demo/use case you want to cover (example: real-time summarization, routing, classification, embeddings for search).
2) Ballpark volume: expected requests per minute or tokens per month (pilot vs steady-state).
3) Target timeline: when do you want a pilot and when do you expect production?

If it helps, here are three 30-minute windows I can offer next week: 
- Tue 9/7 11:00 AM PDT
- Wed 9/8 2:00 PM PDT
- Thu 9/9 9:00 AM PDT

Or pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/bento-demo-30m

We typically cover architecture fit, estimated throughput/cost, and a quick sandbox walkthrough. Neha (cc) will join for the tech portion.

Thanks — quick replies are fine.

Best,
Ben Carter
Inbound SDR | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127

From: Samir Patel <samir@fintrack.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@fintrack.io>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + short qual before demo — FinTrack

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the note — happy to share detail so we can make the demo practical. High level:

- Use case: Invoice AI — extract key fields (vendor, total, due date), classify invoices into workflow buckets, and generate short payment-summary snippets for downstream teams. We're also experimenting with a short natural-language reconciliation assistant for finance ops.
- Volume: Pilot will start small (approx 2M tokens/month) but we expect to ramp to ~50M tokens/month within 3–6 months if results are good. Peak concurrency around invoice ingestion periods might be ~150–250 requests/minute (many are short sequences, average tokens per request ~200).
- Timeline: Pilot target start mid-September (aiming 2026-09-15), production roll by end of Q4 2026.

Security: SOC 2 compliance is required for any vendor we run PII-adjacent workloads with. Can you confirm Redwood's SOC 2 status and whether you provide audit logs and customer-managed keys (KMS)?

Would prefer Tue 9/7 11:00 AM PDT if that slot is available. Also attaching a quick architecture sketch of our current pipeline (fintrack-invoice-flow.png) for context.

Cheers,
Samir Patel
Head of Product — FinTrack
samir@fintrack.io

(Attachment: fintrack-invoice-flow.png)

Samir —

Perfect, thanks for the context — super helpful. Tue 9/7 11:00 AM PDT is available; I penciled it in tentatively. Below is a proposed agenda and a small pre-demo checklist so Neha can set up a sandbox that matches your flow: 

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 0–5m: Intros & goals for the session
- 5–15m: Quick look at your architecture (thanks for the diagram) + fit discussion (throughput, latency targets)
- 15–25m: Live sandbox walkthrough (prefix caching, batching, and token-cost implications)
- 25–30m: Next steps: pilot scope, success metrics, and SOC 2 / security checklist

Pre-demo checklist (what helps us prep):
- Confirm team domains for SSO / SAML check (if needed)
- A small sample invoice (anonymized) or example JSON so we shape prompts/templates
- Any specific redlines on data retention or audit log access

I've attached our short pilot checklist (redwood-pilot-checklist.pdf) that outlines typical deliverables, roles, and expected timeline. We'll also pull together SOC 2 evidence and an audit logs overview ahead of the meeting — Neha will handle those items.

Calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/bento-demo-30m — I can send a calendar invite for Tue 9/7 11:00 AM PDT once you confirm. Would you like the invite to include an optional 60-minute follow-up block in case we need extra time?

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Ben Carter
Inbound SDR | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127

(Attachment: redwood-pilot-checklist.pdf)
